events.title: Bails Cricket League · Season 1
events.description: BAIL'S own league for mixed corporate teams. Twelve teams play in two pools of six: Pool A on Saturdays and Pool B on Sundays. Every team is guaranteed six matches (five league games and a semi-final), and the pool standings feed three cup playoffs, Platinum, Gold and Silver, each with a winner and a runner-up.
events.highlights:
Two pools of 6 teams: Saturday and Sunday
5 league matches + 1 semi-final guaranteed
Three cups: Platinum, Gold and Silver
MVP wins an English willow bat
Best batter: gloves · Best bowler: shoes · Best keeper: keeping gloves
Man of the Match and Fighter of the Match trophies
360° camera coverage
Professional umpires
